apparatus_corrections.original: Conſidering that God hath not only geuen, and beſtovved manie great benefites vpon me, and al mankind, but alſo hath rendered good for euil, mercie for our ſinnes, vve hauing rendered euil for good: vvhat novv ſhal I render, ſayth a true penitent, for al that he hath thus rendered to me, deſeruing ſo euil?
apparatus_corrections.corrected: Conſidering that God hath not only geuen, and beſtowed manie great benefites vpon me, and al mankind, but alſo hath rendered good for euil, mercie for our ſinnes, we hauing rendered euil for good: what now ſhal I render, ſayth a true penitent, for al that he hath thus rendered to me, deſeruing ſo euil?

apparatus_corrections.original: Seing I am not able to render anie thing vvorthie of Gods fauoure to me, yet I vvil do that I can: I vvil gratfully accept his great benefite. the cuppe of Chriſts paſſion, vvhich he druunke for mankind, h and vvil praiſe, and cal vpon his name.
apparatus_corrections.corrected: Seing I am not able to render anie thing worthie of Gods fauoure to me, yet I wil do that I can: I wil gratfully accept his great benefite. the cuppe of Chriſts paſſion, which he druunke for mankind, and wil praiſe, and cal vpon his name.

apparatus_corrections.original: I vvil pay voluntarie vovves, k for Gods glorie, and edification of others. l yea I vvil offer my life, and ſuffer death, vvhen Gods glorie ſhal require it, in vvhoſe ſight, the death of Sainctes is precious, and moſt highly eſteemed.
apparatus_corrections.corrected: I wil pay voluntarie vowes, for Gods glorie, and edification of others. yea I wil offer my life, and ſuffer death, when Gods glorie ſhal require it, in whoſe ſight, the death of Sainctes is precious, and moſt highly eſteemed.
